chat_messages.message: Good morning team! Term 1 assessments are progressing well. Please submit class scores by Friday.
Reminder: PTA meeting this Saturday at 9:00 AM in the main hall.
Staff meeting minutes have been shared. Kindly review before Monday.
Class 4 picnic permission slips — please follow up with parents who haven't signed.
Math mock exam papers are ready for printing. Who can help collate for JHS 2?
Science lab materials list uploaded. Finance approval pending.
French oral exams scheduled for next week — timetables in shared folder.
📢 School fees for Term 1 are due. Parents may pay at the finance office or via MoMo.
📢 Inter-house sports trials begin next Monday. Students should come in PE kits.
